source: DeoVR on a Meta Quest, over Wi-Fi, TCP 23554
note: The first traffic this project has ever seen from a real player. Everything
before this was fake-player answering a client written from the same reading
of the same two documents, so it could only ever confirm our own assumptions.
Three frames is a small sample and it covers one player, one version, one
platform, and about two seconds of steady-state playback. It settles the
framing and the packet shape. It settles nothing about seeking, media
changes, connection teardown, or anything HereSphere does.
The path has been left exactly as received, including the LAN address of the
user's own media server. It is a private RFC1918 address on a home network
and it is load-bearing evidence: it shows DeoVR reports a URL rather than a
filesystem path, which is the single most consequential surprise here for
anything that later wants to resolve the media.
